raw_segments.text: Ah, cried she in French, you speak my language as well as Mr. Rochester does, I can talk
to you as I can to him and so can Sophie.
She will be glad, nobody here understands her, Madame Fairfax is all English.
Sophie is my nurse, she came with me over the sea in a great ship with a chimney that
smoked, how it did smoke, and I was sick and so was Sophie and so was Mr. Rochester.
Mr. Rochester lay down on a sofa in a pretty room called the salon, and Sophie and I had
I nearly fell out of mine, it was like a shelf.
And Madame Wiesel, what is your name?
